Generated 1 CANDIDATE_ONLY cross-domain principle from it. Outcome: CROSS_DOMAIN_PATTERN_FOUND.

lesson: An exact-match structural join (the same discipline E12's Pattern Detection already proved) generalizes cleanly from single-domain pattern detection to cross-domain principle discovery without inventing any new inference mechanism -- the minimal bridge E-series needed was a join key, not a new design.
